description:
The Hotel Castillo de Gorraiz Golf & Spa stands beside a recently restored 16th-century castle, overlooking its own private golf course. Located in the municipality of Valle de Egüés, less than 5 km from Pamplona, it is a sophisticated 4-star superior boutique hotel combining tradition, history, and lifestyle — inside, the fusion of stone, wood, velvet, artwork, and exclusive designer furniture creates a distinctive atmosphere. The property has 87 rooms.

The castle wing has for many years served as a venue for weddings, adding another layer of historic and social significance to the property in the region.

The castle's role as an active wedding venue, alongside its function as a hotel, ties Gorraiz to a specific contemporary social use distinct from the purely heritage-focused roles of most Spanish castle-hotels.

The property's adjoining 18-hole golf course gives Gorraiz a leisure dimension shared with several other Spanish castle resorts, set within Navarre's specific landscape just outside Pamplona.

The castle's position less than 5 km from Pamplona gives guests staying at Gorraiz quick access to the city's historic center, famous for the Running of the Bulls.
